onboarding.demo.shorthandHold: <0>Open your note.</0> <1>Hold your shortcut and talk.</1> <2>Let go, and Shorthand adds what you said to your note.</2>
onboarding.demo.shorthandTap: <0>Open your note.</0> <1>Tap your shortcut and talk.</1> <2>Tap again, and Shorthand adds what you said to your note.</2>
onboarding.demo.shorthandTitle: Talk, and your note keeps up
onboarding.done.shorthandSubMac: Shorthand's in your menu bar now. Press <keys/> to start or stop a capture, then follow along in your note.
onboarding.done.shorthandSubTray: Shorthand's in your system tray now. Press <keys/> to start or stop a capture, then follow along in your note.
onboarding.model.hiddenMatch: Models that can't write live notes are hidden here.
onboarding.model.noLiveNotes: Live notes won't appear with the suggested model for your language.
onboarding.telemetry.intro: Shorthand can send crash reports and a little usage info so problems get found and fixed. It is anonymous, and you can change this any time under Settings → App.
onboarding.telemetry.never.body: Audio, transcripts, notes, file names or paths, API keys, your name, email address or IP address.
onboarding.telemetry.never.heading: What is never sent
onboarding.telemetry.sends.errors: Crash and error reports: what failed and where in the app, with your operating system and Shorthand version.
onboarding.telemetry.sends.heading: What is sent
onboarding.telemetry.sends.usage: Usage info: how many captures finish, in which mode, with which model, and how long they ran.
onboarding.telemetry.title: Help improve Shorthand
onboarding.telemetry.toggle: Send crash reports and usage info
overlay.error.generic: Something went wrong with that recording.
overlay.error.micPermission.macos: Turn it on in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
overlay.error.micPermission.other: Turn on microphone access in your system settings.
overlay.error.micPermission.windows: Turn it on in Windows Settings → Privacy → Microphone.
settings.about.acknowledgments.handy.des: Open-source speech-to-text for the desktop, by CJ Pais
settings.about.acknowledgments.handy.det: Shorthand is a fork of Handy. Recording, local transcription, dictation, the model catalogue and the app itself are Handy's work; Shorthand adds meeting capture and AI note taking on top. Thank you to CJ Pais and the Handy contributors.
settings.about.license.description: Shorthand is free to use. You can also buy a license at a price you choose.
settings.about.license.title: License
settings.about.showAllSettings.descripti: Reveal every setting and transcription model from upstream Handy, including the ones Shorthand hides.
settings.about.showAllSettings.label: Show all Handy settings
settings.advanced.followStream.descripti: Allow local tools to follow live transcript events by running `shorthand --follow-stream`.
settings.advanced.followStream.label: Follow live transcript output
settings.advanced.switch.description: Show every setting, not just the ones most people need. Nothing moves — the extra rows appear in the sections they belong to.
settings.advanced.switch.label: Advanced settings
settings.advanced.systemAudio.descriptio: Capture audio playing through your speakers as a separate speaker-labelled transcription alongside the microphone.
settings.advanced.systemAudio.label: Capture system audio
settings.advanced.systemAudio.muteConfli: Turn off Capture System Audio before enabling Mute While Recording.
settings.advanced.systemAudio.permission: Shorthand needs permission to record audio playing on this Mac. Grant it in System Settings, under Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording. macOS only asks once, so the prompt may not appear again.
settings.advanced.systemAudio.streamingR: System audio capture requires a model that supports streaming.
settings.advanced.systemAudioDevice.desc: Choose the device to capture. Default follows the system default output.
settings.aiCleanup.dictationNote: AI cleanup is intended for Dictation. Enabling it for notetaking is an advanced setting and is not recommended.
settings.aiCleanup.sharedNote: The connection and the prompt library are shared. Whether cleanup runs, and which prompt it uses, is set per mode under Modes.
settings.aiCleanup.title: How AI cleans up what you said
settings.app.telemetry.description: Anonymous crash reports and a little usage info. Never audio, transcripts, notes or personal details.
settings.app.telemetry.label: Send crash reports and usage info
settings.assistedNotes.enable.descriptio: Turn on a solo note-taking mode. It streams what you say to whatever is following along, the same way Meetings does, but records only your microphone and never types into the window you are in.
settings.assistedNotes.enable.label: Enable assisted notes
settings.assistedNotes.enable.shortcutCo: Could not enable assisted notes: another application is already using one of its shortcuts. Choose a different shortcut below and try again.
settings.assistedNotes.privacy.saveRecor: Keep the audio of each assisted-notes session so you can play it back or re-transcribe it.
settings.assistedNotes.privacy.saveTrans: Keep the text of each assisted-notes session in your local history.
settings.dictation.enable.description: Turn on a separate dictation mode, with its own shortcut, that pastes text into whatever window has focus.
settings.dictation.enable.label: Enable dictation
settings.dictation.enable.shortcutConfli: Could not enable dictation: one of its shortcuts is already in use, either by another Shorthand shortcut or another application. Choose a different shortcut below and try again.
settings.dictation.footer: Microphone, model and language come from the Capture and Transcription sections.
settings.dictation.overlayPosition.share: Where the overlay appears on screen. Shared with meeting mode — this isn't a per-mode setting.
settings.dictation.postProcessing.hint: Configure providers, API keys and models in the Post-Processing section.
settings.dictation.privacy.saveRecording: Keep the audio recording for each dictation.
settings.dictation.privacy.saveTranscrip: Keep the transcript text for each dictation.
settings.general.shortcut.bindings.assis: The keyboard shortcut to start and stop an assisted-notes session.
Optional: a dedicated shortcut that always applies AI cleanup to an assisted-notes session.
settings.general.shortcut.bindings.dicta: The keyboard shortcut to start and stop dictation.
Optional: a dedicated hotkey that always applies AI cleanup to your dictation.
settings.models.hiddenByBoth: Some models that match are hidden by the {{preview}} and {{translate}} filters. Turn them off to see them.
settings.models.hiddenByFilter: Some models that match are hidden by the {{filter}} filter. Turn it off to see them.
settings.modes.description: Meetings and Assisted notes both stream what they hear to whatever is following along. Meetings can include the other participants; Assisted notes records only you. Dictation types what you say into the focused window.
settings.modes.heading: How each mode behaves
settings.modes.shared.description: One setting, used by whichever mode is recording.
settings.modes.shared.title: Shared by both modes
settings.modes.tabs.label: Capture mode
settings.notes.agent.args.description: What the program needs to start in ACP mode, separated by spaces. Many need none.
settings.notes.agent.args.title: Arguments
settings.notes.agent.description.acp: Another program that speaks the Agent Client Protocol writes the notes.
settings.notes.agent.description.claude: Claude Code on this computer writes the notes. Sign in to Claude Code first.
settings.notes.agent.description.codex: The Codex command line tool on this computer writes the notes, signed in with your ChatGPT account.
settings.notes.agent.description.cursor: The Cursor command line tool on this computer writes the notes. Sign in to it first.
settings.notes.agent.description.llm: Shorthand sends the transcript to a provider you choose, with your own API key.
settings.notes.agent.endpoint.descriptio: Only for a proxy or gateway. Leave blank to use the provider's own.
Where the server answers. This provider has no default.
settings.notes.agent.endpoint.title: Server URL
settings.notes.agent.key.description: Kept in your system keychain. A key you added in the Obsidian plugin for the same provider works here too.
settings.notes.agent.key.descriptionOpti: Only if your server asks for one. Kept in your system keychain.
settings.notes.agent.key.title: API key
settings.notes.agent.llmModel.descriptio: The model's name, as the provider spells it.
settings.notes.agent.llmModel.title: Model
settings.notes.agent.missing.endpoint: Add the server's URL below, or the next meeting won't get notes.
settings.notes.agent.missing.key: Add your API key below, or the next meeting won't get notes.
settings.notes.agent.missing.model: Add a model below, or the next meeting won't get notes.
settings.notes.agent.missing.program: Add its program below, or the next meeting won't get notes.
settings.notes.agent.model.description: Leave blank to use the tool's default.
settings.notes.agent.model.title: Model
settings.notes.agent.program.description: The full path to the program.
settings.notes.agent.program.title: Program
settings.notes.agent.provider.title: Provider
settings.notes.agent.title: Note taker
settings.notes.google.client.description: Optional. Shorthand signs in with its own Google client. To use yours, add the ID and secret of a Desktop app OAuth client with the drive.file scope.
Signing in with your client. It applies the next time you connect or change the doc.
Add both the client ID and the secret to use your client. Until then Shorthand uses its own.
settings.notes.google.client.title: Your own Google client
settings.notes.google.description: Shorthand writes each meeting's notes into Google Docs as you talk. It can only see the docs and folder it makes or that you choose here.
settings.notes.google.folder.connected: Connected. Each meeting gets a new doc in your folder.
settings.notes.google.folder.connectedNa: Meetings go into "{{name}}", a new doc each time.
settings.notes.google.folder.notConnecte: Not set up yet, so meetings won't be saved. Connect Google and Shorthand makes the folder.
settings.notes.google.folder.signedInNoF: Google is connected, but the folder isn't there yet, so meetings won't be saved.
settings.notes.google.layout.description: A new doc for each meeting, in a folder called Shorthand Meeting Notes. You can move or rename it in Drive. If Meetings saves transcripts, each doc also gets a Transcript tab.
All your meetings go into one doc, each in its own tab. If Meetings saves transcripts, each meeting's tab gets a Transcript tab under it.
settings.notes.google.layout.title: Organize notes
settings.notes.google.status.connected: Connected. Each meeting gets a new tab in your doc.
settings.notes.google.status.connectedNa: Meetings go into "{{name}}", a new tab each time.
settings.notes.google.status.connectedNo: Connected, but this build of Shorthand doesn't include the notes engine, so meetings can't be written to the doc yet.
settings.notes.google.status.connecting: Finish in your browser: sign in to Google, then pick the doc if it asks.
settings.notes.google.status.notConnecte: Not set up yet, so meetings won't be saved. Choose a doc you already have, or let Shorthand create one.
settings.notes.google.status.unavailable: Google sign-in isn't built into this version of Shorthand. Turn on Advanced settings to use your own Google client.
settings.notes.google.title: Google Docs
settings.notes.obsidian.description: The Shorthand plugin for Obsidian follows each capture and writes the note into your vault. It runs inside Obsidian, so that is where it gets installed.
settings.notes.obsidian.status.awaitingO: Obsidian is opening on the plugin's page. Choose Install, then Enable, and come back here. If Obsidian shows its Community plugins settings instead, turn off Restricted mode under Settings → Community plugins and try again.
settings.notes.obsidian.status.checkFail: Could not check whether the plugin is installed: {{error}}
settings.notes.obsidian.status.installed: Installed in {{vault}} but switched off. Turn it on in Obsidian under Settings → Community plugins.
settings.notes.obsidian.status.noVault: Obsidian is installed but has no vault yet. Open or create a vault in Obsidian, then come back here.
settings.notes.obsidian.status.notInstal: Not installed in {{vault}}. Obsidian will open on the plugin's page; choose Install, then Enable.
settings.notes.obsidian.status.obsidianN: Obsidian isn't installed on this computer, or hasn't been opened yet. Install Obsidian and open a vault, then come back here.
settings.notes.obsidian.title: Obsidian

settings.notes.prompts.assisted.title: Assisted notes
